description: Read-only. Paginated member list for a DAO — voting power, delegation counts, rewards, expert status. Pass `chainId` (chains with a pools endpoint here: 56; default 56); the reply echoes `indexedChainId`, never another chain's rows. No endpoint for a chain = an error that names the on-chain reads to use instead.

chainId.description: Chain to read from: 56 mainnet, 97 testnet. Needs an RPC for it. Default: the configured chain.

title: List DAO members with voting power (subgraph)
